name: @volt/dsh-persona-volt
description: VOLT — a live-current persona bundle for DeepSeek Harness. Mounts via a runtime Cordis plugin (inject/apply), so it takes effect the moment the bundle is loaded — no profile-side config required.

hub.summary: Injects the VOLT live-current persona into the system prompt via a runtime section.
hub.description: A portable DSH bundle that mounts the VOLT persona (Chinese) as a runtime prompt section (volt:persona, order -98) through its own Cordis plugin entry. Takes effect on load — the plugin's apply() hook registers the section directly against the systemPrompt service. Zero breakers, fixed output format, electric register.
